# Glide

> Glide turns tracker tickets into pull requests written by AI agents. Ploeg authorizes, budgets and runs every agent Run; Vloer is its front end. Internal, self-hosted, pre-1.0.

Use Ploeg's terms: a Run is one Role executing against a Work Item, a Shift is the whole attempt, and a Lease is the right to write the Shift's branch. Code and executable tests describe the implementation; research and ADR pages are records.
